title: Plot the sigmoid function
description: You evaluate the sigmoid on a grid of input scores.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You create z values across the supplied interval. These values become the horizontal coordinates.

steps.question: What value does the displayed formula assign to z=0?

steps.description: You compute the sigmoid, 1/(1+exp(-z)), at every grid value. The plot pairs each input score with its transformed value.
You label the axes z and sigma(z) and display the chart. The title identifies the transformation as the sigmoid function.
